descriptions.d19c_place_on_floor_800d5028: Read an id through 0x80178c48 from +56; for ids 0..16 whose record (0x800fc6dc) is enabled, compare the record position's Y with the floor height (0x80178df0 of +64 minus that of +204): above it, copy the record's position, velocity and auxiliary vectors to +140/+164/+152; otherwise store the position with Y set to the floor height and reset the velocity to the shared default vector.
